map_info.name: Rotation Spectacle: central tunnel and six stacks
map_info.description: An exhibition hall with a central boolean tunnel and three carousel cakes on either side. Six stacks show five profiles under one layered speed rule, with the original cake repeated as a reference.

learning_objectives: Follow accumulated orientation along a boolean tunnel
Compare five carousel profiles under the same layered rotation rule
Distinguish a repeated spatial angle from angular motion over time
